_evidence: Car record read by 0x0042595c through esi: byte +0x70 (cmp 2, jb exits), byte +0x8d (test 2, jne exits), byte +0x179 (test 1, jne returns; or 1 / and 0xfe later), byte +0x415 (>>1, below 4 gates a random check), movsx words +0xb6 (imul gain), +0x10e (-0x3000, clamped to 0..0x1000: the list straddles both clamp edges), +0x1ac (added to the result), and read-modify-write bytes +0x203 (and 0xdf / or 0x20) and +0x230 (or 0x40 / and 0xbf). The gate bytes favour the pass side but take both; plain u8 draws for +0x415 are small often enough to reach the <4 branch. All values are valid (no division depends on the record).
